title: Genfo
description: Genfo is a Ethiopia classic prepared with barley flour, niter kibbeh. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 12 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Slowly stir the grains into the simmering liquid; cook over low heat for about 22 minutes, stirring to prevent sticking.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 9 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
